info.text:
Nvidia fell 13% last week. Tuesday is its big test.
It was Nvidia's worst week since April 2025, after CEO Jensen Huang resigned (Nvidia 8-K, Nov 12). Tuesday's report (Nov 17, after the close) is its first under interim CEO Colette Kress.
Nvidia's own forecast for the quarter: $108 billion in sales, nearly double the $57 billion of a year ago. Last quarter's sales were $96.2 billion, up 106%.
Nvidia is roughly 6% of a typical S&P 500 index fund (our estimate, Nov 13): about $6 of every $100.
Sources: Nvidia press releases and SEC filings; CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
